description: This 4TU.ResearchData deposit contains data and models used in research on evaluation of existing railway transition structures and a newly proposed structure. The provider metadata identify Avni Jain as the creator and TU Delft, Department of Engineering Structures, as the organization. The native description explicitly identifies models used to create the publication results. The short description does not identify separate output file formats. The resource therefore supplies the source material for the named railway structural analysis. The native format field declares CAE model files. Access is through the existing DOI and repository landing page. The source licence is CC-BY-4.0; the record retains its existing access and cost terms. Geographic extent, observation or simulation dates, spatial resolution and sampling intervals are not stated. The 2025 publication date describes the deposit and does not establish temporal coverage of its contents. Runtime inputs, solver settings and detailed model formulations are also unstated. No model, source-code file or result payload was opened, so accuracy and reproducibility were not tested. The existing related repository record remains linked.
